name: Shrinkwell Image Optimizer
author: levmedia

sections.description:
Optimize images locally, find possibly unused media, and reduce WordPress backup size safely.

Shrinkwell helps you compress images, generate WebP/AVIF, and review possibly unused media before it bloats your backups. Images are processed on your own server, with no external compression API and no account required.

Run a safe 5-image test first, review the results, then optimize your media library with more confidence.

Built for agencies, freelancers and site owners

Shrinkwell is designed for WordPress maintenance, handoff and cleanup work where you need to show what was optimized, what was skipped, and which media may need review.

Safe image optimization

  • Run a 5-image test before touching the full library
  • Compress JPEG and PNG files locally
  • Generate WebP and AVIF within the monthly free limit
  • Resize oversized images
  • Strip EXIF/metadata where supported
  • Optimize thumbnails alongside originals
  • Keep original backups and restore individual images when needed

Safe Media Cleanup

  • Scan your WordPress database for possibly unused media
  • Review confidence levels and source evidence before cleanup
  • See why each image is marked used, protected, possibly unused, or needs review
  • Avoid blind deletion with Shrinkwell Trash
  • Reduce media library clutter and backup size safely

Delivery and proof

  • Confirm WebP delivery on a live frontend URL
  • Review optimization logs with bytes saved, skipped images and skip reasons
  • Run a site scan and apply recommended settings
  • Check missing alt text and weak filenames without auto-rewriting content

Compression profiles

Choose a named compression profile or use custom settings:

  • Balanced: solid savings with sensible quality preservation
  • High: stronger reduction for image-heavy sites
  • Near lossless: minimal visual change for portfolios and product photography
  • Custom: a 1-10 strength slider for full control

Shrinkwell can generate and serve WebP with a safe JPEG/PNG fallback, without .htaccess edits or a CDN requirement.

Free version

The free version includes:

  • 60 MB of image processing per month
  • Local JPEG and PNG optimization
  • WebP and AVIF generation within the monthly limit
  • Resize oversized images
  • Strip EXIF/metadata where supported
  • Optimize thumbnails
  • Preserve existing WebP media items
  • Original backups and restore tools
  • Media Cleanup database scan
  • Possibly unused media preview
  • Confidence and evidence details for cleanup review
  • Optimization log
  • Frontend WebP delivery test
  • Site scan and recommended settings
  • GD and Imagick support
  • No external compression API

Shrinkwell Pro

Shrinkwell Pro is for larger sites and professional maintenance workflows. Pro unlocks unlimited optimization, auto-optimize on upload, background bulk optimization, safe bulk cleanup actions, Shrinkwell Trash, and advanced cleanup tools.

What Shrinkwell does not do

Shrinkwell does not send media files to an external compression API, require an account, charge per image, or automatically rewrite alt text or filenames.

Privacy

Images are optimized on your own server. The free plugin does not transmit media files externally for optimization.

License & Assets

Shrinkwell is licensed under GPLv2 or later.

The included Shrinkwell logo and wordmark are original Levmedia brand assets and are distributed with this plugin under GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate “Shrinkwell Image Optimizer” in WordPress.
  3. Open Media > Shrinkwell.
  4. Save your preferred settings and run the bulk optimizer.
sections.faq:
Does this use an external compression API?

No. It uses the image editor available on your WordPress server, usually GD or Imagick.

Does it convert images to AVIF?

Yes, when the current server passes the local AVIF encoder and safety checks. AVIF can be slower and heavier than WebP on shared hosting, so Shrinkwell skips files that exceed safe local processing limits instead of risking timeouts.

Can I restore originals?

Yes. The plugin creates backup files when “Keep backups for restore” is enabled, and optimized items get a “Restore original” action in the Media Library.

Does the SEO check rewrite alt text or filenames?

The standard SEO check only reports missing alt text and weak filenames so you can review changes manually.
